_comment: Not present in the in-game Custom Search mode list as of 2026-08-05 (Steam capture 20260805170513). EA published no changelog line for the removal, so the in-game screen is the only source; the 'Removed' row comes from data/releases.json, which is authoritative for it. The page is kept because the mode has real patch history in the log. Scope: Custom Search covers core multiplayer only, so this says nothing about REDSEC, Battle Royale, Gauntlet or Portal.
